budget.pricing_policy: 2x standard token price, input UTF-8 bytes + 4096 overhead, maximum output. Reservations never refunded, even on failure. No tools or images called.

decisions.reason: A new game launch trailer is relevant to players, but its wider significance is limited.
A hardware availability announcement may interest PC and AI audiences; details are limited and first-party.
A NASA center leadership appointment is a routine institutional update.
Artemis II heat-shield coverage may be significant, but the brief context gives little detail.
An individual-focused NASA feature is less consequential than mission or program news.
